notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Brigid's Command
description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brigid's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Brigid's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
